quest.title: Pontoon Parkour
quest.description: At Cider Lake, a woman explained her troubles to you.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Ugh... My boyfriend asked me to solve a difficult problem. My head hurts just by thinking about it... Here it is: "<color=#00E1FFFF>You have 5 wood boards. Use them wisely to cross the river.</color>"

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Arranging the 5 wood boards next to each other can only make me go half the distance. If you were to put space between them to reach the other side, the gap would be too big for me to jump across.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: An <color=#00E1FFFF>adult man</color> could jump further... I guess I can't do it after all.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: What do you think? How should we arrange them?

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Are you sure? You'll barely manage to reach half the distance though.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Please wait a moment, I'll arrange them like you asked.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Are you sure? The gap between them would be too big to jump across.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Please wait a moment, I'll arrange them like you asked.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Sure, no problem. I'll take the boards back.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Here goes the challenge! Try to cross the river as quickly as possible! Ready... Go!

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Awww... You couldn't reach the other side in time, just like me.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Bystander
dialogues.text: Wow! Incredible! Thanks to you, I can brag to my boyfriend now!
